Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for this repository: it explains how to build the data from public sources, run the
dashboard locally, check it, and optionally publish it to Microsoft Fabric.

Key rules: the repository ships code only, so never commit generated data (everything listed in `.gitignore`) or any
tenant, workspace, model or item IDs, hosting URLs, tokens or `.env` files. Keep the README's demo disclaimer.
